job.title: [Post] Thái Huỳnh Ngọc Mai (Stephanie)
job.email_subject: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Thái Huỳnh Ngọc Mai,

I saw your hiring post – I bring 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce development on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 / 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell
– OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third parties
– PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; SAP ERP / MDM integration

I work smoothly in international teams across time zones and take ownership up to production. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years building, extending and supporting enterprise B2B and B2C commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, OCC REST APIs for headless storefronts, Promotions Engine, OMS, Impex, Cronjobs and FlexibleSearch, plus PIM / ERP / MDM integrations with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performs code reviews, mentors junior developers and supports production in agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Your post looks for developers to grow your team, and I can add proven enterprise commerce experience: five years on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, from OCC APIs to PIM and ERP integration. I enjoy international teams and want to contribute that platform depth to your projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Stephanie, I saw your hiring post. I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell (Java, Spring, OCC APIs, integrations). Happy to share my CV if a role fits!

en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
en.hook: Your hiring post caught my attention because strong commerce developers are what every e-commerce team needs. I have built and extended enterprise B2B and B2C platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) with Java and Spring for Rockwell Automation and Shell for more than five years – as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

bullets.label: Commerce development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: APIs & headless
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP web services and customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters.

bullets.label: Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Delivery & quality
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) in agile DevOps workflows; led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and supported production troubleshooting.

en.logistics: I work smoothly in international teams across time zones and take ownership up to production. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can contribute from day one.
